## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, relevant issue if any, and what users observe after this change.

## Validation performed

List the actual commands and results. State any checks not run or skipped and why. Follow the [contribution guide](https://github.com/neilmorse/spring-runtime-mcp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for checks appropriate to the change.

## Evidence and limitations

Identify synthetic replay, disposable loopback fixtures, or an authorized live application as applicable. Include the exact versions actually exercised. Record remaining gaps or unknowns; synthetic data alone does not establish live compatibility.

Mention related documentation or contract changes and any effect on dependencies, endpoint permissions, authentication, or output limits. Keep credentials, raw diagnostic bodies, and identifying application data out of the PR.
